lede: Wat Na Dao accounts for 25 catalogued manuscripts, 15 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Lampang (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (96%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (52%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (48%). Dated witnesses run 1835–1961 CE (7 of 25 carry a date).
